PREFIX brick: <http://purl.earing.me/brick#> PREFIX ref: <http://purl.earing.me/reference#> select 
from <http://137.214.66.206:7200/bsb-north>
where
{
  VALUES (?zone 
    "Core_mid"
    "Perimeter_mid_ZN_3"
    "Perimeter_top_ZN_3"
  )
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone ref:hasElectricPower ?sensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid
}
order by ?tsid
